body: Founder: 'the whole game just stops... like the server process died' -- it had. auto_deploy.sh's own scheduled restart killed a match with active combat despite the existing match-aware guard, a real point-in-time pgrep race. Hardened with two independent signals (pgrep re-checked after a settle delay + a new recent-match-log-activity check), either one deferring the restart. Validated live against the currently-running match. Also bumped bot pool back to 20 to get a match running again immediately.
title: Fixed real TOCTOU race in auto-deploy's match-aware restart guard
